answer: Clones sharing one datacenter or one proxy pool produce a kernel signature that collapses to a single origin, which means the cluster is discounted at settlement. Buying 7 genuinely separate vantage points per alias is the farming party's cost, and each one has to keep a orchard record clean through the quill check. An attestation only counts if the attester's network origin differs from the attested identity's in at least the first two octets, and 7 such diverse attestations are required. That is 13 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
